# TradesHub

> Trades showroom for FallHub. Sovereign AI-first operating system configured for plumbers, electricians, decorators, gas engineers, landscapers, roofers, and builders. Service-area kernel with rates, specialities, cert tracking. Quote jobs in seconds. Schedule callouts around emergencies. Chase money on schedule. Never miss a review. Published by AI-Native Solutions. MIT. ◊·κ=1.

## What it is

TradesHub is a vertical showroom pointing at:
- FallHub's trades vertical template
- FallForge's concierge installer
- The trades module stack (FallAccount, FallCRM Elite, FallSecurity, FallBrief, Botler, Cassie Oracle)

Any independent tradesperson or small trades team can deploy FallHub with the TradesHub configuration and get an AI-first operating system that handles quote enquiries, callout scheduling, invoice chasing, review responses, and certificate tracking.

## Signature feature: service-area kernel

TradesHub's kernel encodes: business name, trade, cert numbers (Gas Safe / NICEIC / etc), service area (postcode centre + radius), specialities, not-offered list, callout rate, hourly rate, emergency multiplier, insurance details, chase cadence.

The AI can't quote outside the service radius. Can't promise specialities not offered. Can't undercut rates. Automatically flags certificate expiries 45 days ahead.

## Modules typically installed on TradesHub instances

- FallAccount — bookkeeping, VAT, MTD, mileage tracking
- FallCRM Elite — customer + property history, warranty tracking
- FallSecurity — GDPR for customer data, DBS records, insurance evidence
- FallBrief — Consumer Rights Act 2015 dispute wording, warranty clauses
- Botler — in-browser LLM for on-van drafting (patchy signal on remote jobs)
- Cassie Oracle — local competitor watch, rate benchmarking
